task: V4S cache local registered command address
hypothesis: The cache command address arithmetic is combinational through top arbitration into engine address fault checking. Capture the cache address before command valid using the already allocated preparation cycle, keeping both arithmetic and row increment local.

changes.F_PREP: capture row0 = base + tile_y*4*SRC_W + tile_x*64, then enter existing F_CMD
changes.F_WRITE: At word7 of each nonfinal row, fill_addr<=fill_addr+SRC_W together with fill_row++ and existing F_CMD transition. No final-row increment.
changes.cmd_addr: directly driven from fill_addr; unchanged through F_CMD backpressure and F_WAIT
unchanged: S/L/M/R lookup pipeline and owner/relookup rules
all DDR command handshakes and watchdogs
